description: This PHP source file manages the routing configuration UI for RIP protocol settings on a network device. It includes PHP code for server-side includes and data handling, embedded HTML for the settings form, CSS for styling, and JavaScript (jQuery) for dynamic interactivity and AJAX-based saving of configuration data.

methods.name: initPopulate
methods.description: Populates the form fields with current RIP configuration settings fetched from a server-side variable.

methods.name: initEventHandler
methods.description: Sets the enabled/disabled state of authentication input fields based on the selected authentication type.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Sends the updated routing configuration data via AJAX to be persisted on the server.
